english.title: Knowingly cause / permit person to operate a regulated facility without authorisation of environmental permit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly,

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to operate a regulated facility, namely **(..SPECIFY FACILITY..), other than under and to the extent authorised by an environmental permit
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(1)(a), 38(1)(b) and 39(1) of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly caused / knowingly permitted
a person to
contravene regulation 12(1)(a)
by operating a regulated facility
not under or to the extent authorised by an environmental permit

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes: Regulation 40 provides a defence to to the offence being made out where it can be proved that the acts undertaken were done in an emergency to avoid danger to human health, the individual took steps that were reasonably practicable in the circumstances for minimising pollution and the particulars of the act were furnished to the regulator as soon as reasonably practicable after they were done.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine. Note:
In relation to an offence committed before paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020 comes into force (01/12/20), the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.Time limits for prosecutions:
None
